contract: A half-open probe lease can be settled only by the outcome for the exact epoch and probe sequence that acquired it. A late pre-open request may update its own metrics but cannot release or decide the half-open probe. At most one probe is admitted in that epoch.

expectedFindings.symptom: An old request starts in epoch0.
expectedFindings.source: An old request starts in epoch0. Another failure opens epoch1; the cooldown admits probe(epoch1,seq3). The old success invokes settle while half-open. Without matching the lease, it closes the breaker and clears the probe while the real probe still runs, allowing another request. A matched lease preserves half-open occupancy until its owner settles.
expectedFindings.consequence: The supplied contract is violated in the bounded driver schedule; no production impact or permanent leakage is established.
expectedFindings.remedy: Bind outcome mutation to the epoch and sequence recorded at admission, leaving old completion telemetry separate from breaker ownership.

Without matching the lease, it closes the breaker and clears the probe while the real probe still runs, allowing another request. A matched lease preserves half-open occupancy until its owner settles.

Explain at least one relevant boundary or benign path inferable from the supplied code/context; the following evaluator examples are alternatives, not a mandatory unseen checklist: Current probe success closes; current probe failure reopens with fresh cooldown; old failure cannot reopen a later epoch; duplicate settlement cannot mutate a new probe.
